We started daycare at 6.5 months because I had to go back to work. I’m lucky that I can do half days at the moment and that my daycare has 1:1 teacher student ratio for the little ones, but overall it’s been so good. I know everyone online is saying “social interaction is not important for children that young” but people tend to forget that it means that the effects of the social aspect in day care under one is not statistically significant. But that does not mean that it’s harmful. In fact, modern parenting that is so much focused on one primary caregiver is kind of a myth itself and children can form relationships with several caregivers. I was really worried before starting daycare mainly because i felt like I couldn’t bear being separated from him for so long but actually it’s been great and I think it made me feel lighter overall. His teacher is very kind and i can tell she really likes my baby. I also enjoy hearing her observations about him. It’s like I’ve gained not exactly a friend but someone who is on my team and cares about my baby. That’s nice for him too. Anyway I’m mostly saying this for anyone reading who might have to send their baby to daycare earlier. I feel like there is a lot of information that makes mums feel guilty on social media… Sissel, I hope Noa is having a great start at daycare, very exciting!
